articles.company_name: Calamos Long/Short Equity & Dynamic Income Trust
articles.summary: Since its launch three years ago, Calamos Convertible Equity Alternative ETF (CVRT) has demonstrated just how compelling equity-sensitive convertible securities can be. In this Q&A, Senior Co-Portfolio Managers Joe Wysocki and Jon Vacko discuss the exciting opportunities they see ahead.
articles.title: Three Years in, CVRT’s Targeted Approach Has Been on Target
